Name: Measure has no format string
Description: Every measure should set a FormatString so visuals render consistently.

Name: Measure is not in a display folder
Description: Loose measures clutter the field list; put each in a DisplayFolder.

Name: Numeric key should not summarize
Description: Foreign/primary key columns should have SummarizeBy = None so they don't sum by accident.

Name: Key / technical column should be hidden
Description: Key and underscore-prefixed technical columns should not be visible to report authors.

Name: Visible measure has no description
Description: Visible measures should carry a description for consumers and documentation.
